verdict.rationale: Honeycomb steers developers to the vendor-neutral OpenTelemetry SDKs for instrumentation, with documented custom spans, attributes, and metrics [honeycomb-docs-1, honeycomb-docs-30, honeycomb-docs-31]. Its own Beeline SDKs appear only as a legacy path users are told to migrate away from [honeycomb-docs-41]. For the management API, the docs offer a downloadable OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling rather than first-party client libraries [honeycomb-docs-11, honeycomb-docs-21]; the probe's 404s were only on guessed spec paths, so they don't contradict this. Missing for 10: official Honeycomb-maintained API client SDKs, documented language coverage for any first-party SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
